blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A bitter family dispute turned violent Wednesday morning after a 45-year-old man allegedly stabbed his younger brother during a heated argument at Purok 4, Sitio Guan, Barangay Batangan here. The 40-year-old male victim sustained a stab wound on the left side of his armpit during the altercation. Responding personnel from the Valencia City Police Station (CPS), who received a telephone call about the incident at around 2:40 a.m., discovered that the victim had already been rushed to the hospital for medical treatment.
